flora: Bennettitales (squat trunk, crown of stiff cycad-like fronds)

environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; emphasize the unique 'trunk-flowers'; fronds are stiff and leathery; rounded, stout proportions to the main stem.

visual_logic.composition: A close-up focusing on the trunk of a Bennettitalean plant, highlighting the strange, petal-like reproductive structures emerging from the bark.
